issues.issue: Did the officer breach procedural fairness by relying on new information without giving the applicant a chance to respond?
issues.applicant_position: Officer relied on post-application reports, unknown to applicant, without giving her a chance to respond.
issues.respondent_position: Officer could research independently; applicant could have updated submissions before the decision.
issues.result_text: Reliance on important new information without opportunity to comment breached procedural fairness; application allowed.

issues.issue: Was the officer's H&C refusal reasonable in light of conditions in Somalia and the ADR?
issues.applicant_position: Challenges the reasonableness and fairness of the officer's H&C determination on Somalia conditions.
issues.result_text: Court finds the fairness breach sufficient and need not decide reasonableness.
